Market today: The big talk is about the Fed potentially messing up monetary policy. This kind of uncertainty usually makes tech and chip stocks, which you're heavy in, pretty nervous and can lead to bigger drops.

Your holdings: SOXL (-52.98%) and SPAL (-60.56%) are getting absolutely hammered. Remember, these are leveraged and decay, and margin makes those losses sting extra hard. QQQI (-5.88%), QQQ (-3.63%), and SMH (-14.2%) are also in the red and flagged for attention, with their stops uncomfortably close.

Watch: Keep a very close eye on any new Fed comments or hints about their next moves. Also, be ready to act on your stops for QQQI, QQQ, and SMH.

Bottom line: Your leveraged bets are a huge liability right now; prioritize cutting losses and protecting your capital.
plays: SOXL: This leveraged chip ETF is down over 50%. Seriously consider trimming or exiting to stop the bleeding and reduce margin risk.
SPAL: Down over 60% and new. Re-evaluate if this extreme volatility and decay is worth the margin exposure.
QQQ & SMH: Respect your stops at 670 for QQQ and 540 for SMH. These are flagged for trim and close to their limits.
